name: decider-path1
readout: next-token logits of the option letters at the answer position, one forward pass, nothing generated

limits.truncation: head/tail of the state when over the limit; never refused

calibration_fit.on: own generated dev items, fitted on the vLLM serving path's raw outputs; mixture of frozen-hard holdouts (t1hold 170, t5hold 210) and sampled easy dev_cal_clean items chosen so that per-type ACCURACY matches the official per-type competence of the same frozen recipe (deck-31B v1.6.1: choice CC 83.9, noul 78.1); never JevBench items
calibration_fit.objective: per type: CC + calibration part; score T fixed at 1.0 (expected-level metric)
calibration_fit.public_check_not_fitted_on: 231 public items, serving path: argmax 213, I 80.1, C 92.2, cap 86.2 (dev-fitted policy 84.4; sensitivity over noul targets 0.90-0.94: 85.2-86.2)

targets.choice: accuracy 0.878 from the official deck-31B choice CC 83.9
targets.noul: accuracy 0.925 = public 0.946 minus the ~2-point public-sealed gap (the official noul CC is depressed by abstentions and not usable)
